contract.regret: R_T(0)=sum_{t=1}^T (loss_t(x_t)-loss_t(0)); exact factor1/2, zero initial point and comparator.
contract.guarantee: Choose a unit vector v and m=ceil(T/2). Let loss_t(z)=-<v,z> for source t<=m and +<v,z> thereafter. Each loss is globally differentiable, convex and 1-Lipschitz. Its actual gradient and the canonical OSD selected subgradient both equal the signed unit vector. Induction identifies the two actual trajectories at every time; their pre-update regret sums agree. Apply the accepted switching_vector_lower_bound to obtain the same exact half-phi bound. The loss stream may depend on T; no fixed infinite witness or Tendsto theorem is asserted.
